Estimate the blind fair value for this option-level event contract.

CONTRACT:
- Market question: Will the Republican Party control the Senate after the 2026 Midterm elections?
- Resolution criteria: This market will resolve according to the party that controls the Senate following the 2026 U.S. Senate elections scheduled for November 3, 2026.

Senate control is defined as having more than half of the voting Senate members, or half of the voting Senate members and the Vice Presidency.

If the outcome of this election is ambiguous given the above rules, this market will remain open until the Majority Leader of the US Senate is selected following the 2026 US general election, at which point it will resolve to the party the majority leader is affiliated with at the time of their election to that position. If the elected majority leader does not caucus with any listed party this market will resolve “Other”.

Determination of which party controls the Senate after the 2026 US Senate elections will be based on a consensus of credible reporting, or if there is ambiguity, final federal and/or state election authority certification or other final official determination of the 2026 election results.
- Category: politics
- Region: US
- End date: 2026-11-03T00:00:00+00:00

IMPORTANT BLINDNESS RULE:
You are not given the market price, bid, ask, spread, volume, or order-book data. Do not guess the market price. Estimate your own fair probability only.

evidence_packet.resolution_criteria:
This market will resolve according to the party that controls the Senate following the 2026 U.S. Senate elections scheduled for November 3, 2026.

Senate control is defined as having more than half of the voting Senate members, or half of the voting Senate members and the Vice Presidency.

If the outcome of this election is ambiguous given the above rules, this market will remain open until the Majority Leader of the US Senate is selected following the 2026 US general election, at which point it will resolve to the party the majority leader is affiliated with at the time of their election to that position. If the elected majority leader does not caucus with any listed party this market will resolve “Other”.

Determination of which party controls the Senate after the 2026 US Senate elections will be based on a consensus of credible reporting, or if there is ambiguity, final federal and/or state election authority certification or other final official determination of the 2026 election results.

Estimate the blind fair value for this option-level event contract.

CONTRACT:
- Market question: Will the Republican Party control the House after the 2026 Midterm elections?
- Resolution criteria: This market will resolve according to the party that controls the House of Representatives following the 2026 U.S. House elections scheduled for November 3, 2026.

House control is defined as having more than half of the voting members of the U.S. House of Representatives.

If the outcome of this election is ambiguous given the above rules, this market will remain open until the Speaker of the House is selected following the 2026 U.S. general election, at which point it will resolve to the party the Speaker is affiliated with at the time of their election to that position. If the elected Speaker does not caucus with any listed party this market will resolve “Other”.

Determination of which party controls the House after the 2026 U.S. House elections will be based on a consensus of credible reporting, or if there is ambiguity, final federal and/or state election authority certification or other final official determination of the 2026 election results.

- Region: US

This market will resolve according to the party that controls the House of Representatives following the 2026 U.S. House elections scheduled for November 3, 2026.

House control is defined as having more than half of the voting members of the U.S. House of Representatives.

If the outcome of this election is ambiguous given the above rules, this market will remain open until the Speaker of the House is selected following the 2026 U.S. general election, at which point it will resolve to the party the Speaker is affiliated with at the time of their election to that position. If the elected Speaker does not caucus with any listed party this market will resolve “Other”.

Determination of which party controls the House after the 2026 U.S. House elections will be based on a consensus of credible reporting, or if there is ambiguity, final federal and/or state election authority certification or other final official determination of the 2026 election results.

results.prompt_used:
Estimate the blind fair value for this option-level event contract.

CONTRACT:
- Market question: Will the Democrats win the Maine Senate race in 2026?
- Resolution criteria: This market will resolve according to the winner of the 2026 midterm Maine U.S. Senate election, inclusive of any run-offs.

A candidate shall be considered to represent a party in the event that he or she is the nominee of the party in question. Candidates other than the Democratic or Republican nominee (e.g., Greens, Libertarian, independent) may be added at a later date.

Candidates who run as independents will not be encompassed by the “Democrat” or “Republican” options regardless of any affiliation they may have with the party.

The resolution source for this market is the Associated Press, Fox News, and NBC. This market will resolve once all three sources call the race for the same candidate. If all three sources haven’t called the race in this state for the same candidate, this market will resolve based on the official certification.
- Category: politics
- Region: US
- End date: None

IMPORTANT BLINDNESS RULE:
You are not given the market price, bid, ask, spread, volume, or order-book data. Do not guess the market price. Estimate your own fair probability only.

results.prompt_used:
Estimate the blind fair value for this option-level event contract.

CONTRACT:
- Market question: Will the Democrats win the Ohio Senate race in 2026?
- Resolution criteria: This market will resolve according to the winner of the 2026 Ohio U.S. Senate special election currently scheduled for November 3, inclusive of any run-offs.

A candidate shall be considered to represent a party in the event that he or she is the nominee of the party in question. Candidates other than the Democratic or Republican nominee (e.g., Greens, Libertarian, independent) may be added at a later date.

Candidates who run as independents will not be encompassed by the “Democrat” or “Republican” options regardless of any affiliation they may have with the party.

The resolution source for this market is the Associated Press, Fox News, and NBC. This market will resolve once all three sources call the race for the same candidate. If all three sources haven’t called the race in this state for the same candidate, this market will resolve based on the official certification.
- Category: politics
- Region: US
- End date: None

IMPORTANT BLINDNESS RULE:
You are not given the market price, bid, ask, spread, volume, or order-book data. Do not guess the market price. Estimate your own fair probability only.

News article about a Democratic primary race in Michigan, not directly related to the Ohio Senate race.

{
  "fair_value": number between 0 and 1,

results.prompt_used:
Estimate the blind fair value for this option-level event contract.

CONTRACT:
- Market question: Will the Democrats win the North Carolina Senate race in 2026?
- Resolution criteria: This market will resolve according to the winner of the 2026 midterm North Carolina U.S. Senate election, inclusive of any run-offs.

A candidate shall be considered to represent a party in the event that he or she is the nominee of the party in question. Candidates other than the Democratic or Republican nominee (e.g., Greens, Libertarian, independent) may be added at a later date.

Candidates who run as independents will not be encompassed by the “Democrat” or “Republican” options regardless of any affiliation they may have with the party.

The resolution source for this market is the Associated Press, Fox News, and NBC. This market will resolve once all three sources call the race for the same candidate. If all three sources haven’t called the race in this state for the same candidate, this market will resolve based on the official certification.
- Category: politics
- Region: US
- End date: None

IMPORTANT BLINDNESS RULE:
You are not given the market price, bid, ask, spread, volume, or order-book data. Do not guess the market price. Estimate your own fair probability only.

EVIDENCE PACKET:
### The 9 Senate seats most likely to flip in 2026 - CNN
The article discusses the 9 Senate seats most likely to flip in 2026, including North Carolina.
(source: Google News RSS, published: 2026-08-10T10:00:29+00:00)

### Tracking key primary elections across the U.S. - LiveNOW from FOX
News article from Google News RSS discussing tracking of key primary elections across the U.S., including the North Carolina Senate race.
(source: Google News RSS, published: 2026-08-08T17:53:41+00:00)

### NEW: Race Raters Shift FOUR Senate Races Toward Democrats as Momentum Builds for Democrats - dscc.org
News article indicates that race raters have shifted four Senate races, including North Carolina, toward Democrats as momentum builds for Democrats.
(source: Google News RSS, published: 2026-08-08T00:24:29+00:00)

### El-Sayed and Stevens Project Party Unity After Divisive Race - nytimes.com
Article discusses party unity after a divisive race, but does not mention North Carolina Senate race or specific candidates.
(source: Google News RSS, published: 2026-08-05T21:15:23+00:00)

OUTPUT JSON SCHEMA:
{
  "fair_value": number between 0 and 1,
  "confidence": number between 0 and 1,
  "should_abstain": boolean,
  "rationale_short": string, max 500 characters,
  "key_uncertainties": array of 1 to 5 short strings,
  "base_rate_notes": string, max 300 characters
}

Calibration guidance:
- 0.50 means true tossup.
- 0.10 means unlikely but plausible.
- 0.01 means very unlikely but not impossible.
- 0.90 means very likely but not certain.
- Avoid 0 or 1 unless resolution is already certain.
- If you abstain, still provide your best fair_value, but set confidence low.

results.prompt_used:
Estimate the blind fair value for this option-level event contract.

CONTRACT:
- Market question: Will the Republicans win the Ohio governor race in 2026?
- Resolution criteria: This market will resolve according to the winner of the 2026 Ohio gubernatorial election.

A candidate shall be considered to represent a party in the event that he or she is the nominee of the party in question. Candidates other than the Democratic or Republican nominee (e.g., Greens, Libertarian, independent) may be added at a later date.

Candidates who run as independents will not be encompassed by the “Democrat” or “Republican” options regardless of any affiliation they may have with the party.

The resolution source for this market is the Associated Press, Fox News, and NBC. This market will resolve once all three sources call the race for the same candidate. If all three sources haven’t called the race in this state for the same candidate, this market will resolve based on the official certification.
- Category: politics
- Region: US
- End date: None

IMPORTANT BLINDNESS RULE:
You are not given the market price, bid, ask, spread, volume, or order-book data. Do not guess the market price. Estimate your own fair probability only.

EVIDENCE PACKET:

Article discusses potential parallels between past Democratic Ohio governor election and current Republican gubernatorial race.
(source: Google News RSS, published: 2026-08-08T00:15:00+00:00)

Article discusses challenges faced by Republicans in Ohio governor race 2026, indicating potential difficulties for GOP candidates.
(source: Google News RSS, published: 2026-08-04T09:14:37+00:00)

{
  "fair_value": number between 0 and 1,
  "confidence": number between 0 and 1,

  "rationale_short": string, max 500 characters,
  "key_uncertainties": array of 1 to 5 short strings,

- 0.50 means true tossup.
- 0.10 means unlikely but plausible.
- 0.01 means very unlikely but not impossible.
- 0.90 means very likely but not certain.
- Avoid 0 or 1 unless resolution is already certain.
- If you abstain, still provide your best fair_value, but set confidence low.

results.prompt_used:
Estimate the blind fair value for this option-level event contract.

CONTRACT:
- Market question: Will Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva win the 2026 Brazilian presidential election?
- Resolution criteria: A presidential election is scheduled to take place in Brazil on October 4, 2026.

This market will resolve according to the listed candidate that wins this election.

This market includes any potential second round. If the result of this election isn't known by June 30, 2027, 11:59 PM ET, the market will resolve to "Other".

This market will resolve based on the result of the election as indicated by a consensus of credible reporting. If there is ambiguity, this market will resolve based solely on the official results as reported by the Brazilian government, specifically the Superior Electoral Court (Tribunal Superior Eleitoral, TSE) (e.g., https://dadosabertos.tse.jus.br/).
- Category: politics
- Region: Brazil
- End date: 2026-10-04T00:00:00+00:00

IMPORTANT BLINDNESS RULE:
You are not given the market price, bid, ask, spread, volume, or order-book data. Do not guess the market price. Estimate your own fair probability only.

EVIDENCE PACKET:
### Brazil’s economy is growing under Lula. Why don’t voters feel it? - The Christian Science Monitor
Article discusses Brazil's economic growth under Lula but notes that voters are not feeling the benefits.
(source: Google News RSS, published: 2026-08-07T17:15:10+00:00)

### Amid foreign interference, Brazil’s election kicks off with a whimper - The Economist
The Economist article discusses foreign interference in Brazil's election, which may impact the outcome.
(source: Google News RSS, published: 2026-08-06T13:00:25+00:00)

### Flávio Bolsonaro announces his running mate for Brazil's October election in a bid against Lula - ABC News - Breaking News, Latest News and Videos
Flávio Bolsonaro announces his running mate for Brazil's October election, positioning against Lula.
(source: Google News RSS, published: 2026-08-05T19:17:08+00:00)

### Brazil's Lula launches reelection bid as concerns rise over foreign interference - Bozeman Daily Chronicle
Lula launches reelection bid amid foreign interference concerns
(source: Google News RSS, published: 2026-08-05T17:30:01+00:00)

### Trump Looms Over Brazil’s Closely Fought Election - WSJ
Article discusses Trump's influence on Brazil's election, which could impact Lula's chances.
(source: Google News RSS, published: 2026-08-05T16:55:00+00:00)

OUTPUT JSON SCHEMA:
{
  "fair_value": number between 0 and 1,
  "confidence": number between 0 and 1,
  "should_abstain": boolean,
  "rationale_short": string, max 500 characters,
  "key_uncertainties": array of 1 to 5 short strings,
  "base_rate_notes": string, max 300 characters
}

Calibration guidance:
- 0.50 means true tossup.
- 0.10 means unlikely but plausible.
- 0.01 means very unlikely but not impossible.
- 0.90 means very likely but not certain.
- Avoid 0 or 1 unless resolution is already certain.
- If you abstain, still provide your best fair_value, but set confidence low.
